column1: # aws components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Read-only: nothing here changes a resource.
mode    ec2      -      EC2 instances in the selected Region, running first          default
mode    logs     -      CloudWatch log groups in the selected Region                 -
mode    ecs      -      ECS clusters in the selected Region                          -
mode    eks      -      EKS clusters in the selected Region                          -
mode    rds      -      RDS instances in the selected Region, available first        -
toggle  running  alt-a  ec2: only running instances                                  -
sort    state    -      ec2: running first; rds: available first                     default
sort    name     -      ec2, logs, ecs, eks, rds: by name                            -
sort    size     -      logs: most stored data first                                 desc
action  console  alt-O  open in the AWS console                                      silent
action  logs     ctrl-l  ec2: console output in the pager; logs: follow, several merged (ctrl-c returns)  foreground
action  inspect  alt-i  the API's JSON in the pager                                  foreground
